datasets.name: ds_kpi_totals
queryLines: SELECT   COUNT(DISTINCT space_id) AS total_spaces,   COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN activity_status = 'Active (last 7 days)' THEN space_id END) AS active_this_week,   (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_identity.email) FROM system.access.audit    WHERE service_name = 'aibiGenie' AND request_params.space_id IS NOT NULL AND request_params.space_id != 'new') AS active_genie_users,   SUM(total_messages) AS total_questions,   ROUND(SUM(thumbs_up) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(thumbs_up) + SUM(thumbs_down), 0), 2) AS satisfaction_rate FROM genie_monitoring.dashboard.genie_space_inventory

datasets.name: ds_daily_trends
queryLines: WITH daily_usage AS (  SELECT event_date, SUM(messages_sent) AS messages, COUNT(DISTINCT user_email) AS users, COUNT(DISTINCT space_id) AS active_spaces  FROM genie_monitoring.dashboard.genie_daily_usage GROUP BY event_date), warehouse_costs AS (  SELECT DATE(u.usage_start_time) AS usage_day, usage_metadata.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id, u.workspace_id,    SUM(usage_quantity * CAST(lp.pricing.default AS DOUBLE)) AS total_cost_usd  FROM system.billing.usage u  LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp ON u.sku_name = lp.sku_name AND u.cloud = lp.cloud AND u.usage_start_time >= lp.price_start_time AND (lp.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_start_time < lp.price_end_time)  WHERE u.billing_origin_product = 'SQL' AND usage_metadata.warehouse_id IS NOT NULL  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3), daily_query_time AS (  SELECT DATE(start_time) AS query_day, compute.warehouse_id, workspace_id,    SUM(total_duration_ms) AS total_ms,    SUM(CASE WHEN client_application = 'Databricks SQL Genie Space' THEN total_duration_ms ELSE 0 END) AS genie_ms  FROM system.query.history GROUP BY 1, 2, 3), daily_cost AS (  SELECT wc.usage_day AS event_date,    ROUND(SUM(wc.total_cost_usd * qt.genie_ms / NULLIF(qt.total_ms, 0)), 2) AS daily_genie_cost  FROM warehouse_costs wc  LEFT JOIN daily_query_time qt ON wc.workspace_id = qt.workspace_id AND wc.warehouse_id = qt.warehouse_id AND wc.usage_day = qt.query_day  GROUP BY 1  HAVING SUM(wc.total_cost_usd * qt.genie_ms / NULLIF(qt.total_ms, 0)) > 0) SELECT du.event_date, du.messages, du.users, du.active_spaces, COALESCE(dc.daily_genie_cost, 0) AS daily_genie_cost FROM daily_usage du LEFT JOIN daily_cost dc ON du.event_date = dc.event_date ORDER BY du.event_date

datasets.name: ds_spaces
queryLines: SELECT   space_name,   workspace_name,   activity_status,   unique_users AS active_genie_users,   total_messages,   COALESCE(CAST(ROUND(satisfaction_pct, 0) AS INT), 0) AS satisfaction_score,   last_activity,   creator_email FROM genie_monitoring.dashboard.genie_space_inventory ORDER BY total_messages DESC

datasets.name: ds_status_breakdown
queryLines: SELECT   activity_status,   COUNT(*) AS space_count FROM genie_monitoring.dashboard.genie_space_inventory GROUP BY activity_status

datasets.name: ds_feedback
queryLines: SELECT feedback_type, COUNT(*) AS feedback_count FROM genie_monitoring.dashboard.genie_feedback_detail GROUP BY feedback_type

datasets.name: ds_top_spaces
queryLines: SELECT   space_name,   workspace_name,   total_messages,   unique_users AS active_genie_users,   COALESCE(CAST(ROUND(satisfaction_pct, 0) AS INT), 0) AS satisfaction_score FROM genie_monitoring.dashboard.genie_space_inventory WHERE total_messages > 0 ORDER BY total_messages DESC LIMIT 10

datasets.name: ds_workspace_detail
queryLines: SELECT   i.workspace_name,   COUNT(DISTINCT i.space_id) AS total_spaces,   u.unique_users AS active_genie_users,   SUM(i.total_messages) AS questions_asked,   ROUND(SUM(i.thumbs_up) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(i.thumbs_up) + SUM(i.thumbs_down), 0), 2) AS satisfaction_rate,   COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.activity_status = 'Active (last 7 days)' THEN i.space_id END) AS active_this_week FROM genie_monitoring.dashboard.genie_space_inventory i LEFT JOIN (   SELECT COALESCE(wl.workspace_name, CAST(a.workspace_id AS STRING)) AS workspace_name,     COUNT(DISTINCT a.user_identity.email) AS unique_users   FROM system.access.audit a   LEFT JOIN (SELECT workspace_id, workspace_name FROM system.access.workspaces_latest) wl ON a.workspace_id = wl.workspace_id   WHERE a.service_name = 'aibiGenie' AND a.request_params.space_id IS NOT NULL AND a.request_params.space_id != 'new'   GROUP BY COALESCE(wl.workspace_name, CAST(a.workspace_id AS STRING)) ) u ON i.workspace_name = u.workspace_name GROUP BY i.workspace_name, u.unique_users ORDER BY questions_asked DESC

datasets.name: ds_top_workspaces
queryLines: SELECT   workspace_name,   SUM(total_messages) AS questions_asked FROM genie_monitoring.dashboard.genie_space_inventory GROUP BY workspace_name ORDER BY questions_asked DESC LIMIT 5

datasets.name: ds_fastest_growing
queryLines: SELECT   workspace_name,   SUM(current_questions) AS current_questions,   SUM(previous_questions) AS previous_questions,   SUM(current_questions) - SUM(previous_questions) AS questions_change FROM genie_monitoring.dashboard.genie_growth WHERE period = 'Last 30 days' GROUP BY workspace_name HAVING SUM(current_questions) - SUM(previous_questions) > 0 ORDER BY questions_change DESC LIMIT 5

datasets.name: ds_space_drilldown
queryLines: SELECT   COALESCE(an.display_name, CONCAT('Unnamed Space (', LEFT(du.space_id, 8), '...)')) AS space_name,   du.workspace_name,   du.event_date,   SUM(du.messages_sent) AS questions,   COUNT(DISTINCT du.user_email) AS users,   SUM(du.positive_feedback) AS positive,   SUM(du.negative_feedback) AS negative,   SUM(du.comments) AS comments FROM genie_monitoring.dashboard.genie_daily_usage du LEFT JOIN (   SELECT request_params.space_id AS space_id, any_value(request_params.display_name) AS display_name   FROM system.access.audit WHERE service_name = 'aibiGenie' AND action_name = 'updateSpace'   AND request_params.display_name IS NOT NULL AND request_params.display_name != ''   GROUP BY request_params.space_id ) an ON du.space_id = an.space_id GROUP BY COALESCE(an.display_name, CONCAT('Unnamed Space (', LEFT(du.space_id, 8), '...)')), du.workspace_name, du.event_date ORDER BY du.event_date

datasets.name: ds_space_feedback
queryLines: SELECT   COALESCE(an.display_name, CONCAT('Unnamed Space (', LEFT(fd.space_id, 8), '...)')) AS space_name,   fd.feedback_type,   COUNT(*) AS feedback_count FROM genie_monitoring.dashboard.genie_feedback_detail fd LEFT JOIN (   SELECT request_params.space_id AS space_id, any_value(request_params.display_name) AS display_name   FROM system.access.audit WHERE service_name = 'aibiGenie' AND action_name = 'updateSpace'   AND request_params.display_name IS NOT NULL AND request_params.display_name != ''   GROUP BY request_params.space_id ) an ON fd.space_id = an.space_id GROUP BY COALESCE(an.display_name, CONCAT('Unnamed Space (', LEFT(fd.space_id, 8), '...)')), fd.feedback_type

datasets.name: ds_growth_combined
queryLines: WITH periods AS (   SELECT 'Last 7 days' AS period, date_sub(current_date(), 7) AS ps, date_sub(current_date(), 1) AS pe, date_sub(current_date(), 14) AS pps, date_sub(current_date(), 8) AS ppe   UNION ALL SELECT 'Last 30 days', date_sub(current_date(), 30), date_sub(current_date(), 1), date_sub(current_date(), 60), date_sub(current_date(), 31)   UNION ALL SELECT 'Last 90 days', date_sub(current_date(), 90), date_sub(current_date(), 1), date_sub(current_date(), 180), date_sub(current_date(), 91) ), audit_names AS (   SELECT request_params.space_id AS sid, any_value(request_params.display_name) AS dn   FROM system.access.audit WHERE service_name = 'aibiGenie' AND action_name = 'updateSpace' AND request_params.display_name IS NOT NULL AND request_params.display_name != ''   GROUP BY request_params.space_id ), daily AS (   SELECT p.period,     CASE WHEN DATE(a.event_time) BETWEEN p.ps AND p.pe THEN 'Current Period' ELSE 'Previous Period' END AS period_label,     DATE(a.event_time) AS event_date,     COALESCE(an.dn, CONCAT('Unnamed Space (', LEFT(a.request_params.space_id, 8), '...)')) AS space_name,     COALESCE(wl.workspace_name, CAST(a.workspace_id AS STRING)) AS workspace_name,     COUNT(CASE WHEN a.action_name IN ('createConversationMessage','genieStartConversationMessage','genieCreateConversationMessage') THEN 1 END) AS questions,     COUNT(DISTINCT a.user_identity.email) AS users   FROM system.access.audit a   CROSS JOIN periods p   LEFT JOIN audit_names an ON a.request_params.space_id = an.sid   LEFT JOIN (SELECT workspace_id, workspace_name FROM system.access.workspaces_latest) wl ON a.workspace_id = wl.workspace_id   WHERE a.service_name = 'aibiGenie' AND a.request_params.space_id IS NOT NULL AND a.request_params.space_id != 'new'     AND DATE(a.event_time) BETWEEN p.pps AND p.pe   GROUP BY p.period,     CASE WHEN DATE(a.event_time) BETWEEN p.ps AND p.pe THEN 'Current Period' ELSE 'Previous Period' END,     DATE(a.event_time),     COALESCE(an.dn, CONCAT('Unnamed Space (', LEFT(a.request_params.space_id, 8), '...)')),     COALESCE(wl.workspace_name, CAST(a.workspace_id AS STRING)) ), growth AS (   SELECT period, space_name,     SUM(CASE WHEN period_label = 'Current Period' THEN questions ELSE 0 END) AS current_questions,     SUM(CASE WHEN period_label = 'Previous Period' THEN questions ELSE 0 END) AS previous_questions,     SUM(CASE WHEN period_label = 'Current Period' THEN questions ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN period_label = 'Previous Period' THEN questions ELSE 0 END) AS questions_change,     CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN period_label = 'Previous Period' THEN questions ELSE 0 END) > 0       THEN ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN period_label = 'Current Period' THEN questions ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN period_label = 'Previous Period' THEN questions ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN period_label = 'Previous Period' THEN questions ELSE 0 END), 1)       WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN period_label = 'Current Period' THEN questions ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS questions_pct_change,     CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN period_label = 'Current Period' THEN questions ELSE 0 END) >= SUM(CASE WHEN period_label = 'Previous Period' THEN questions ELSE 0 END) THEN 'Growing' ELSE 'Declining' END AS trend,     SUM(CASE WHEN period_label = 'Current Period' THEN users ELSE 0 END) AS current_users,     SUM(CASE WHEN period_label = 'Previous Period' THEN users ELSE 0 END) AS previous_users   FROM daily   GROUP BY period, space_name   HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN period_label = 'Current Period' THEN questions ELSE 0 END) > 0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN period_label = 'Previous Period' THEN questions ELSE 0 END) > 0 ) SELECT d.period, d.period_label, d.event_date, d.space_name, d.workspace_name, d.questions, d.users,   g.current_questions, g.previous_questions, g.questions_change, g.questions_pct_change, g.trend, g.current_users, g.previous_users FROM daily d JOIN growth g ON d.period = g.period AND d.space_name = g.space_name ORDER BY d.event_date

datasets.name: ds_ws_events
queryLines: SELECT workspace_name, user_email, is_positive FROM (   SELECT DISTINCT     COALESCE(wl.workspace_name, CAST(a.workspace_id AS STRING)) AS workspace_name,     a.user_identity.email AS user_email,     CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS is_positive   FROM system.access.audit a   LEFT JOIN (SELECT workspace_id, workspace_name FROM system.access.workspaces_latest) wl ON a.workspace_id = wl.workspace_id   WHERE a.service_name = 'aibiGenie' AND a.request_params.space_id IS NOT NULL AND a.request_params.space_id != 'new'   UNION ALL   SELECT     COALESCE(wl.workspace_name, CAST(a.workspace_id AS STRING)) AS workspace_name,     CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS user_email,     CASE WHEN a.request_params.feedback_rating = 'THUMBS_UP' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS is_positive   FROM system.access.audit a   LEFT JOIN (SELECT workspace_id, workspace_name FROM system.access.workspaces_latest) wl ON a.workspace_id = wl.workspace_id   WHERE a.service_name = 'aibiGenie' AND a.action_name = 'updateConversationMessageFeedback'     AND a.request_params.feedback_rating IN ('THUMBS_UP', 'THUMBS_DOWN') )

datasets.name: ds_space_events
queryLines: SELECT space_name, user_email, is_positive FROM (   SELECT DISTINCT     COALESCE(an.display_name, CONCAT('Unnamed Space (', LEFT(a.request_params.space_id, 8), '...)')) AS space_name,     a.user_identity.email AS user_email,     CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS is_positive   FROM system.access.audit a   LEFT JOIN (     SELECT request_params.space_id AS sid, any_value(request_params.display_name) AS display_name     FROM system.access.audit WHERE service_name = 'aibiGenie' AND action_name = 'updateSpace'     AND request_params.display_name IS NOT NULL AND request_params.display_name != ''     GROUP BY request_params.space_id   ) an ON a.request_params.space_id = an.sid   WHERE a.service_name = 'aibiGenie' AND a.request_params.space_id IS NOT NULL AND a.request_params.space_id != 'new'   UNION ALL   SELECT     COALESCE(an.display_name, CONCAT('Unnamed Space (', LEFT(a.request_params.space_id, 8), '...)')) AS space_name,     CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS user_email,     CASE WHEN a.request_params.feedback_rating = 'THUMBS_UP' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS is_positive   FROM system.access.audit a   LEFT JOIN (     SELECT request_params.space_id AS sid, any_value(request_params.display_name) AS display_name     FROM system.access.audit WHERE service_name = 'aibiGenie' AND action_name = 'updateSpace'     AND request_params.display_name IS NOT NULL AND request_params.display_name != ''     GROUP BY request_params.space_id   ) an ON a.request_params.space_id = an.sid   WHERE a.service_name = 'aibiGenie' AND a.action_name = 'updateConversationMessageFeedback'     AND a.request_params.feedback_rating IN ('THUMBS_UP', 'THUMBS_DOWN') )

datasets.name: ds_ws_feedback
queryLines: SELECT workspace_name, feedback_type, COUNT(*) AS feedback_count FROM genie_monitoring.dashboard.genie_feedback_detail GROUP BY workspace_name, feedback_type

datasets.name: ds_cost_kpis
queryLines: WITH warehouse_costs AS (   SELECT usage_metadata.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id, u.workspace_id,     ROUND(SUM(usage_quantity * CAST(lp.pricing.default AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS total_cost_usd   FROM system.billing.usage u   LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp ON u.sku_name = lp.sku_name AND u.cloud = lp.cloud AND u.usage_start_time >= lp.price_start_time AND (lp.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_start_time < lp.price_end_time)   WHERE u.billing_origin_product = 'SQL' AND u.usage_date >= date_sub(current_date(), 30) AND usage_metadata.warehouse_id IS NOT NULL   GROUP BY 1, 2 ), query_time AS (   SELECT compute.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id, workspace_id,     SUM(total_duration_ms) AS total_ms,     SUM(CASE WHEN client_application = 'Databricks SQL Genie Space' THEN total_duration_ms ELSE 0 END) AS genie_ms   FROM system.query.history WHERE start_time >= date_sub(current_date(), 30) GROUP BY 1, 2 ), ws_genie_cost AS (   SELECT wc.workspace_id,     SUM(wc.total_cost_usd * qt.genie_ms / NULLIF(qt.total_ms, 0)) AS genie_cost   FROM warehouse_costs wc   LEFT JOIN query_time qt ON wc.workspace_id = qt.workspace_id AND wc.warehouse_id = qt.warehouse_id   GROUP BY 1   HAVING SUM(wc.total_cost_usd * qt.genie_ms / NULLIF(qt.total_ms, 0)) > 0 ), space_time AS (   SELECT query_source.genie_space_id AS space_id, compute.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id, workspace_id, SUM(total_duration_ms) AS genie_ms   FROM system.query.history WHERE client_application = 'Databricks SQL Genie Space' AND start_time >= date_sub(current_date(), 30) AND query_source.genie_space_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ), wh_total_time AS (   SELECT workspace_id, compute.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id, SUM(total_duration_ms) AS total_ms   FROM system.query.history WHERE start_time >= date_sub(current_date(), 30) GROUP BY 1, 2 ), space_cost AS (   SELECT st.space_id, SUM(wc.total_cost_usd * st.genie_ms / NULLIF(wt.total_ms, 0)) AS cost   FROM space_time st   LEFT JOIN warehouse_costs wc ON st.workspace_id = wc.workspace_id AND st.warehouse_id = wc.warehouse_id   LEFT JOIN wh_total_time wt ON st.workspace_id = wt.workspace_id AND st.warehouse_id = wt.warehouse_id   GROUP BY 1 HAVING SUM(wc.total_cost_usd * st.genie_ms / NULLIF(wt.total_ms, 0)) > 0 ) SELECT   ROUND((SELECT SUM(genie_cost) FROM ws_genie_cost), 2) AS total_genie_cost,   ROUND((SELECT AVG(genie_cost) FROM ws_genie_cost), 2) AS avg_cost_per_workspace,   ROUND((SELECT AVG(cost) FROM space_cost), 2) AS avg_cost_per_space,   (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM system.query.history WHERE client_application = 'Databricks SQL Genie Space' AND start_time >= date_sub(current_date(), 30)) AS genie_queries_30d,   (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT executed_by) FROM system.query.history WHERE client_application = 'Databricks SQL Genie Space' AND start_time >= date_sub(current_date(), 30)) AS genie_users_30d

datasets.name: ds_workload_comparison
queryLines: SELECT   CASE     WHEN client_application = 'Databricks SQL Genie Space' THEN 'Genie Space'     WHEN query_source.dashboard_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'AI/BI Dashboard'     WHEN query_source.legacy_dashboard_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Legacy Dashboard'     WHEN query_source.notebook_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Notebook'     WHEN query_source.job_info.job_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Job'     ELSE 'Ad Hoc / Other'   END AS source_type,   COUNT(*) AS queries,   COUNT(DISTINCT executed_by) AS unique_users,   ROUND(SUM(total_duration_ms)/1000.0/3600.0, 2) AS compute_hours,   ROUND(SUM(read_bytes)/1024/1024/1024, 2) AS data_read_gb,   ROUND(AVG(total_duration_ms)/1000.0, 2) AS avg_query_sec FROM system.query.history WHERE start_time >= date_sub(current_date(), 30) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY queries DESC

datasets.name: ds_monthly_trend
queryLines: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', start_time) AS month,   COUNT(*) AS queries,   COUNT(DISTINCT executed_by) AS users,   ROUND(SUM(total_duration_ms)/1000.0/3600.0, 2) AS compute_hours,   ROUND(SUM(read_bytes)/1073741824.0, 1) AS gb_scanned FROM system.query.history WHERE query_source.genie_space_id IS NOT NULL   AND start_time >= date_sub(current_date(), 180) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

datasets.name: ds_cost_by_workspace
queryLines: SELECT   COALESCE(wl.workspace_name, CAST(u.workspace_id AS STRING)) AS workspace_name,   ROUND(SUM(u.usage_quantity), 1) AS total_dbus,   ROUND(SUM(u.usage_quantity * CAST(lp.pricing.default AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS cost_usd FROM system.billing.usage u LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp ON u.sku_name = lp.sku_name AND u.cloud = lp.cloud AND u.usage_start_time >= lp.price_start_time AND (lp.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_start_time < lp.price_end_time) LEFT JOIN (SELECT workspace_id, workspace_name FROM system.access.workspaces_latest) wl ON u.workspace_id = wl.workspace_id WHERE u.billing_origin_product = 'SQL' AND u.usage_date >= date_sub(current_date(), 30) GROUP BY 1 HAVING SUM(u.usage_quantity) > 0 ORDER BY cost_usd DESC

datasets.name: ds_genie_user_showback
queryLines: SELECT   q.executed_by AS user_email,   COALESCE(wl.workspace_name, CAST(q.workspace_id AS STRING)) AS workspace_name,   COUNT(*) AS queries,   COUNT(DISTINCT query_source.genie_space_id) AS spaces_used,   ROUND(SUM(q.total_duration_ms)/1000.0/3600.0, 4) AS compute_hours,   ROUND(SUM(q.read_bytes)/1024/1024, 1) AS data_read_mb FROM system.query.history q LEFT JOIN (SELECT workspace_id, workspace_name FROM system.access.workspaces_latest) wl ON q.workspace_id = wl.workspace_id WHERE q.client_application = 'Databricks SQL Genie Space' AND q.start_time >= date_sub(current_date(), 30) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY queries DESC

datasets.name: ds_genie_value
queryLines: SELECT   COALESCE(wl.workspace_name, CAST(q.workspace_id AS STRING)) AS workspace_name,   COUNT(*) AS total_queries,   COUNT(DISTINCT q.executed_by) AS unique_users,   ROUND(COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT q.executed_by), 1) AS queries_per_user,   ROUND(AVG(q.total_duration_ms)/1000.0, 2) AS avg_query_sec,   COUNT(DISTINCT query_source.genie_space_id) AS spaces_used,   COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(q.start_time)) AS active_days FROM system.query.history q LEFT JOIN (SELECT workspace_id, workspace_name FROM system.access.workspaces_latest) wl ON q.workspace_id = wl.workspace_id WHERE q.client_application = 'Databricks SQL Genie Space' AND q.start_time >= date_sub(current_date(), 30) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total_queries DESC

datasets.name: ds_ws_cost
queryLines: WITH warehouse_costs AS (   SELECT u.workspace_id, usage_metadata.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id,     ROUND(SUM(usage_quantity * CAST(lp.pricing.default AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS total_cost_usd   FROM system.billing.usage u   LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp ON u.sku_name = lp.sku_name AND u.cloud = lp.cloud AND u.usage_start_time >= lp.price_start_time AND (lp.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_start_time < lp.price_end_time)   WHERE u.billing_origin_product = 'SQL' AND u.usage_date >= date_sub(current_date(), 30) AND usage_metadata.warehouse_id IS NOT NULL   GROUP BY 1, 2 ), query_time AS (   SELECT workspace_id, compute.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id,     SUM(total_duration_ms) AS total_ms,     SUM(CASE WHEN client_application = 'Databricks SQL Genie Space' THEN total_duration_ms ELSE 0 END) AS genie_ms,     SUM(CASE WHEN query_source.dashboard_id IS NOT NULL THEN total_duration_ms ELSE 0 END) AS dashboard_ms   FROM system.query.history WHERE start_time >= date_sub(current_date(), 30) GROUP BY 1, 2 ) SELECT   COALESCE(wl.workspace_name, CAST(wc.workspace_id AS STRING)) AS workspace_name,   ROUND(SUM(wc.total_cost_usd), 2) AS total_sql_cost,   ROUND(SUM(wc.total_cost_usd * qt.genie_ms / NULLIF(qt.total_ms, 0)), 2) AS genie_cost,   ROUND(SUM(wc.total_cost_usd * qt.dashboard_ms / NULLIF(qt.total_ms, 0)), 2) AS dashboard_cost FROM warehouse_costs wc LEFT JOIN query_time qt ON wc.workspace_id = qt.workspace_id AND wc.warehouse_id = qt.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT workspace_id, workspace_name FROM system.access.workspaces_latest) wl ON wc.workspace_id = wl.workspace_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total_sql_cost DESC

datasets.name: ds_space_cost
queryLines: WITH space_queries AS (   SELECT query_source.genie_space_id AS space_id,     compute.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id,     q.workspace_id,     COUNT(*) AS queries,     COUNT(DISTINCT executed_by) AS users,     SUM(total_duration_ms) AS genie_ms,     ROUND(SUM(read_bytes)/1024/1024, 1) AS data_read_mb   FROM system.query.history q   WHERE client_application = 'Databricks SQL Genie Space' AND start_time >= date_sub(current_date(), 30)     AND query_source.genie_space_id IS NOT NULL   GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ), warehouse_costs AS (   SELECT u.workspace_id, usage_metadata.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id,     ROUND(SUM(usage_quantity * CAST(lp.pricing.default AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS total_cost   FROM system.billing.usage u   LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp ON u.sku_name = lp.sku_name AND u.cloud = lp.cloud AND u.usage_start_time >= lp.price_start_time AND (lp.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_start_time < lp.price_end_time)   WHERE u.billing_origin_product = 'SQL' AND u.usage_date >= date_sub(current_date(), 30) AND usage_metadata.warehouse_id IS NOT NULL   GROUP BY 1, 2 ), wh_total_time AS (   SELECT workspace_id, compute.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id, SUM(total_duration_ms) AS total_ms   FROM system.query.history WHERE start_time >= date_sub(current_date(), 30) GROUP BY 1, 2 ), audit_names AS (   SELECT request_params.space_id AS space_id, any_value(request_params.display_name) AS display_name   FROM system.access.audit WHERE service_name = 'aibiGenie' AND action_name = 'updateSpace' AND request_params.display_name IS NOT NULL AND request_params.display_name != ''   GROUP BY 1 ) SELECT   COALESCE(an.display_name, CONCAT('Unnamed Space (', LEFT(sq.space_id, 8), '...)')) AS space_name,   COALESCE(wl.workspace_name, CAST(sq.workspace_id AS STRING)) AS workspace_name,   SUM(sq.queries) AS queries,   MAX(sq.users) AS users,   ROUND(SUM(sq.genie_ms)/1000.0, 1) AS compute_sec,   SUM(sq.data_read_mb) AS data_read_mb,   ROUND(SUM(wc.total_cost * sq.genie_ms / NULLIF(wt.total_ms, 0)), 2) AS estimated_cost FROM space_queries sq LEFT JOIN warehouse_costs wc ON sq.workspace_id = wc.workspace_id AND sq.warehouse_id = wc.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN wh_total_time wt ON sq.workspace_id = wt.workspace_id AND sq.warehouse_id = wt.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN audit_names an ON sq.space_id = an.space_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT workspace_id, workspace_name FROM system.access.workspaces_latest) wl ON sq.workspace_id = wl.workspace_id GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY estimated_cost DESC

datasets.name: ds_genie_cost_distribution
queryLines: WITH warehouse_costs AS (   SELECT usage_metadata.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id, u.workspace_id,     ROUND(SUM(usage_quantity * CAST(lp.pricing.default AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS total_cost_usd   FROM system.billing.usage u   LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp ON u.sku_name = lp.sku_name AND u.cloud = lp.cloud AND u.usage_start_time >= lp.price_start_time AND (lp.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_start_time < lp.price_end_time)   WHERE u.billing_origin_product = 'SQL' AND u.usage_date >= date_sub(current_date(), 30) AND usage_metadata.warehouse_id IS NOT NULL   GROUP BY 1, 2 ), query_time AS (   SELECT compute.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id, workspace_id,     SUM(total_duration_ms) AS total_ms,     SUM(CASE WHEN client_application = 'Databricks SQL Genie Space' THEN total_duration_ms ELSE 0 END) AS genie_ms   FROM system.query.history WHERE start_time >= date_sub(current_date(), 30) GROUP BY 1, 2 ) SELECT   COALESCE(wl.workspace_name, CAST(wc.workspace_id AS STRING)) AS workspace_name,   ROUND(SUM(wc.total_cost_usd * qt.genie_ms / NULLIF(qt.total_ms, 0)), 2) AS genie_cost FROM warehouse_costs wc LEFT JOIN query_time qt ON wc.workspace_id = qt.workspace_id AND wc.warehouse_id = qt.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT workspace_id, workspace_name FROM system.access.workspaces_latest) wl ON wc.workspace_id = wl.workspace_id GROUP BY 1 HAVING SUM(wc.total_cost_usd * qt.genie_ms / NULLIF(qt.total_ms, 0)) > 0.01 ORDER BY genie_cost DESC LIMIT 5

datasets.name: ds_top5_space_cost
queryLines: WITH space_queries AS (   SELECT query_source.genie_space_id AS space_id,     compute.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id,     q.workspace_id,     COUNT(*) AS queries,     COUNT(DISTINCT executed_by) AS users,     SUM(total_duration_ms) AS genie_ms,     ROUND(SUM(read_bytes)/1024/1024, 1) AS data_read_mb   FROM system.query.history q   WHERE client_application = 'Databricks SQL Genie Space' AND start_time >= date_sub(current_date(), 30)     AND query_source.genie_space_id IS NOT NULL   GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ), warehouse_costs AS (   SELECT u.workspace_id, usage_metadata.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id,     ROUND(SUM(usage_quantity * CAST(lp.pricing.default AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS total_cost   FROM system.billing.usage u   LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp ON u.sku_name = lp.sku_name AND u.cloud = lp.cloud AND u.usage_start_time >= lp.price_start_time AND (lp.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_start_time < lp.price_end_time)   WHERE u.billing_origin_product = 'SQL' AND u.usage_date >= date_sub(current_date(), 30) AND usage_metadata.warehouse_id IS NOT NULL   GROUP BY 1, 2 ), wh_total_time AS (   SELECT workspace_id, compute.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id, SUM(total_duration_ms) AS total_ms   FROM system.query.history WHERE start_time >= date_sub(current_date(), 30) GROUP BY 1, 2 ), audit_names AS (   SELECT request_params.space_id AS space_id, any_value(request_params.display_name) AS display_name   FROM system.access.audit WHERE service_name = 'aibiGenie' AND action_name = 'updateSpace' AND request_params.display_name IS NOT NULL AND request_params.display_name != ''   GROUP BY 1 ) SELECT   COALESCE(an.display_name, CONCAT('Unnamed Space (', LEFT(sq.space_id, 8), '...)')) AS space_name,   COALESCE(wl.workspace_name, CAST(sq.workspace_id AS STRING)) AS workspace_name,   SUM(sq.queries) AS queries,   MAX(sq.users) AS users,   ROUND(SUM(sq.genie_ms)/1000.0, 1) AS compute_sec,   SUM(sq.data_read_mb) AS data_read_mb,   ROUND(SUM(wc.total_cost * sq.genie_ms / NULLIF(wt.total_ms, 0)), 2) AS estimated_cost FROM space_queries sq LEFT JOIN warehouse_costs wc ON sq.workspace_id = wc.workspace_id AND sq.warehouse_id = wc.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN wh_total_time wt ON sq.workspace_id = wt.workspace_id AND sq.warehouse_id = wt.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN audit_names an ON sq.space_id = an.space_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT workspace_id, workspace_name FROM system.access.workspaces_latest) wl ON sq.workspace_id = wl.workspace_id GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY estimated_cost DESC LIMIT 5

datasets.name: ds_ws_daily_activity
queryLines: SELECT workspace_name, event_date,  SUM(messages_sent) AS messages,  COUNT(DISTINCT user_email) AS users,  COUNT(DISTINCT space_id) AS active_spaces FROM genie_monitoring.dashboard.genie_daily_usage GROUP BY workspace_name, event_date ORDER BY event_date

datasets.name: ds_ws_top_users
queryLines: SELECT workspace_name, user_email,  SUM(messages_sent) AS questions_asked,  COUNT(DISTINCT space_id) AS spaces_used,  SUM(positive_feedback) AS thumbs_up,  SUM(negative_feedback) AS thumbs_down,  MAX(event_date) AS last_active FROM genie_monitoring.dashboard.genie_daily_usage WHERE messages_sent > 0 GROUP BY workspace_name, user_email ORDER BY questions_asked DESC

datasets.name: ds_ws_daily_cost
queryLines: WITH warehouse_costs AS (  SELECT DATE(u.usage_start_time) AS usage_day, usage_metadata.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id, u.workspace_id,    SUM(usage_quantity * CAST(lp.pricing.default AS DOUBLE)) AS total_cost_usd  FROM system.billing.usage u  LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp ON u.sku_name = lp.sku_name AND u.cloud = lp.cloud AND u.usage_start_time >= lp.price_start_time AND (lp.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_start_time < lp.price_end_time)  WHERE u.billing_origin_product = 'SQL' AND usage_metadata.warehouse_id IS NOT NULL  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3), daily_query_time AS (  SELECT DATE(start_time) AS query_day, compute.warehouse_id, workspace_id,    SUM(total_duration_ms) AS total_ms,    SUM(CASE WHEN client_application = 'Databricks SQL Genie Space' THEN total_duration_ms ELSE 0 END) AS genie_ms  FROM system.query.history GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) SELECT  COALESCE(wl.workspace_name, CAST(wc.workspace_id AS STRING)) AS workspace_name,  wc.usage_day AS event_date,  ROUND(SUM(wc.total_cost_usd * qt.genie_ms / NULLIF(qt.total_ms, 0)), 2) AS daily_genie_cost FROM warehouse_costs wc LEFT JOIN daily_query_time qt ON wc.workspace_id = qt.workspace_id AND wc.warehouse_id = qt.warehouse_id AND wc.usage_day = qt.query_day LEFT JOIN (SELECT workspace_id, workspace_name FROM system.access.workspaces_latest) wl ON wc.workspace_id = wl.workspace_id GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING SUM(wc.total_cost_usd * qt.genie_ms / NULLIF(qt.total_ms, 0)) > 0 ORDER BY event_date

datasets.name: ds_engagement_kpis
queryLines: WITH messages AS (   SELECT user_identity.email AS user_email, event_date   FROM system.access.audit   WHERE service_name = 'aibiGenie'     AND action_name IN ('createConversationMessage', 'genieStartConversationMessage', 'genieCreateConversationMessage')     AND request_params['space_id'] IS NOT NULL ), user_stats AS (   SELECT user_email, COUNT(*) AS questions, COUNT(DISTINCT event_date) AS active_days   FROM messages GROUP BY user_email ), tiers AS (   SELECT CASE WHEN questions >= 50 AND active_days >= 10 THEN 'Power User' WHEN questions >= 10 AND active_days >= 3 THEN 'Regular' ELSE 'Casual' END AS tier, user_email, questions   FROM user_stats ), conv AS (   SELECT COALESCE(request_params['conversation_id'], request_id) AS cid   FROM system.access.audit   WHERE service_name = 'aibiGenie' AND action_name IN ('createConversationMessage', 'genieStartConversationMessage', 'genieCreateConversationMessage') AND request_params['space_id'] IS NOT NULL ), conv_depth AS (   SELECT cid, COUNT(*) AS msg_count FROM conv GROUP BY cid ), cost AS (   SELECT COUNT(*) AS genie_queries, ROUND(SUM(total_duration_ms) / 1000.0 / 3600.0, 2) AS compute_hours, ROUND(SUM(read_bytes) / 1073741824.0, 1) AS gb_scanned, ROUND(AVG(total_duration_ms) / 1000.0, 1) AS avg_query_sec   FROM system.query.history WHERE query_source.genie_space_id IS NOT NULL ) SELECT   ROUND(SUM(t.questions) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT t.user_email), 1) AS avg_questions_per_user,   COUNT(DISTINCT t.user_email) AS total_users,   ROUND((SELECT AVG(msg_count) FROM conv_depth), 1) AS avg_msgs_per_conversation,   ROUND((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN msg_count >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) FROM conv_depth), 2) AS multi_turn_pct,   (SELECT genie_queries FROM cost) AS total_genie_queries,   (SELECT compute_hours FROM cost) AS total_compute_hours,   (SELECT gb_scanned FROM cost) AS total_gb_scanned,   (SELECT avg_query_sec FROM cost) AS avg_query_seconds FROM tiers t

datasets.name: ds_engagement_tiers
queryLines: WITH user_stats AS (   SELECT user_identity.email AS user_email, COUNT(*) AS questions, COUNT(DISTINCT event_date) AS active_days   FROM system.access.audit   WHERE service_name = 'aibiGenie'     AND action_name IN ('createConversationMessage', 'genieStartConversationMessage', 'genieCreateConversationMessage')     AND request_params['space_id'] IS NOT NULL   GROUP BY user_identity.email ) SELECT CASE WHEN questions >= 50 AND active_days >= 10 THEN 'Power User' WHEN questions >= 10 AND active_days >= 3 THEN 'Regular' ELSE 'Casual' END AS engagement_tier, COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM user_stats GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY user_count DESC

datasets.name: ds_weekly_new_users
queryLines: WITH first_use AS (   SELECT user_identity.email AS user_email, MIN(event_date) AS first_date   FROM system.access.audit   WHERE service_name = 'aibiGenie'     AND action_name IN ('createConversationMessage', 'genieStartConversationMessage', 'genieCreateConversationMessage')     AND request_params['space_id'] IS NOT NULL   GROUP BY user_identity.email ) SELECT DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', first_date) AS week_start, COUNT(*) AS new_users FROM first_use GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', first_date) ORDER BY week_start

datasets.name: ds_stickiness
queryLines: WITH weekly_users AS (   SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', event_date) AS month_start, DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', event_date) AS week_start, COUNT(DISTINCT user_identity.email) AS wau   FROM system.access.audit   WHERE service_name = 'aibiGenie'     AND action_name IN ('createConversationMessage', 'genieStartConversationMessage', 'genieCreateConversationMessage')     AND request_params['space_id'] IS NOT NULL   GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', event_date), DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', event_date) ), monthly_users AS (   SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', event_date) AS month_start, COUNT(DISTINCT user_identity.email) AS mau   FROM system.access.audit   WHERE service_name = 'aibiGenie'     AND action_name IN ('createConversationMessage', 'genieStartConversationMessage', 'genieCreateConversationMessage')     AND request_params['space_id'] IS NOT NULL   GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', event_date) ) SELECT m.month_start, m.mau, ROUND(AVG(w.wau), 0) AS avg_wau, ROUND(AVG(w.wau) * 1.0 / NULLIF(m.mau, 0), 2) AS stickiness_ratio FROM monthly_users m JOIN weekly_users w ON m.month_start = w.month_start GROUP BY m.month_start, m.mau ORDER BY m.month_start

datasets.name: ds_conversation_depth
queryLines: WITH conversations AS (   SELECT COALESCE(request_params['conversation_id'], request_id) AS conversation_id   FROM system.access.audit   WHERE service_name = 'aibiGenie'     AND action_name IN ('createConversationMessage', 'genieStartConversationMessage', 'genieCreateConversationMessage')     AND request_params['space_id'] IS NOT NULL ), conv_depth AS (   SELECT conversation_id, COUNT(*) AS msg_count FROM conversations GROUP BY conversation_id ) SELECT CASE WHEN msg_count = 1 THEN '1 message' WHEN msg_count = 2 THEN '2 messages' WHEN msg_count = 3 THEN '3 messages' WHEN msg_count BETWEEN 4 AND 5 THEN '4-5 messages' ELSE '6+ messages' END AS conversation_depth, COUNT(*) AS conversation_count FROM conv_depth GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY MIN(msg_count)

datasets.name: ds_satisfaction_trend
queryLines: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', event_date) AS month_start,   SUM(CASE WHEN request_params['feedback_rating'] = 'THUMBS_UP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS thumbs_up,   SUM(CASE WHEN request_params['feedback_rating'] = 'THUMBS_DOWN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS thumbs_down,   COUNT(*) AS total_feedback,   ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN request_params['feedback_rating'] = 'THUMBS_UP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS satisfaction_rate FROM system.access.audit WHERE service_name = 'aibiGenie' AND action_name = 'updateConversationMessageFeedback' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', event_date) ORDER BY month_start

datasets.name: ds_health_kpis
queryLines: WITH askers AS (   SELECT user_identity.email AS email, event_date   FROM system.access.audit   WHERE service_name = 'aibiGenie'     AND action_name IN ('createConversationMessage', 'genieStartConversationMessage', 'genieCreateConversationMessage')     AND request_params['space_id'] IS NOT NULL ), dau AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT email) AS dau FROM askers WHERE event_date = date_sub(current_date(), 1)), wau AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT email) AS wau FROM askers WHERE event_date >= date_sub(current_date(), 7)), mau AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT email) AS mau FROM askers WHERE event_date >= date_sub(current_date(), 28)), viewers AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_identity.email) AS viewer_count FROM system.access.audit WHERE service_name = 'aibiGenie' AND action_name IN ('getSpace', 'genieGetSpace') AND event_date >= date_sub(current_date(), 28)), asker_count AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT email) AS asker_count FROM askers WHERE event_date >= date_sub(current_date(), 28)), repeat_users AS (   SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a1.email) AS repeat_count FROM askers a1   INNER JOIN askers a2 ON a1.email = a2.email AND a2.event_date > a1.event_date AND a2.event_date <= date_add(a1.event_date, 7)   WHERE a1.event_date >= date_sub(current_date(), 28) ), space_counts AS (   SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT request_params['space_id']) AS total_spaces,     COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(current_date(), event_date) > 30 AND request_params['space_id'] NOT IN (       SELECT DISTINCT request_params['space_id'] FROM system.access.audit WHERE service_name = 'aibiGenie'         AND action_name IN ('createConversationMessage', 'genieStartConversationMessage', 'genieCreateConversationMessage')         AND request_params['space_id'] IS NOT NULL AND event_date >= date_sub(current_date(), 30)     ) THEN request_params['space_id'] END) AS stale_spaces   FROM system.access.audit WHERE service_name = 'aibiGenie'     AND action_name IN ('createConversationMessage', 'genieStartConversationMessage', 'genieCreateConversationMessage')     AND request_params['space_id'] IS NOT NULL ), query_stats AS (   SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN execution_status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 3) AS unanswered_rate,     ROUND(AVG(total_duration_ms) / 1000.0, 1) AS avg_latency_sec,     ROUND(PERCENTILE(total_duration_ms, 0.5) / 1000.0, 1) AS p50_latency_sec,     ROUND(SUM(total_duration_ms) / 1000.0 / 3600.0, 2) AS total_compute_hours   FROM system.query.history WHERE query_source.genie_space_id IS NOT NULL AND start_time >= date_sub(current_date(), 28) ) SELECT (SELECT dau FROM dau) AS dau, (SELECT wau FROM wau) AS trailing_7d_users, (SELECT mau FROM mau) AS trailing_28d_users,   ROUND((SELECT asker_count FROM asker_count) * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT viewer_count FROM viewers), 0), 2) AS login_to_use_pct,   ROUND((SELECT repeat_count FROM repeat_users) * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT asker_count FROM asker_count), 0), 2) AS repeat_usage_rate,   (SELECT unanswered_rate FROM query_stats) AS unanswered_rate,   (SELECT avg_latency_sec FROM query_stats) AS avg_latency_sec,   (SELECT p50_latency_sec FROM query_stats) AS p50_latency_sec,   (SELECT total_compute_hours FROM query_stats) AS query_cost_hours,   (SELECT total_spaces FROM space_counts) AS total_spaces,   (SELECT stale_spaces FROM space_counts) AS stale_spaces

datasets.name: ds_dau_trend
queryLines: WITH daily AS (   SELECT event_date, user_identity.email AS email FROM system.access.audit   WHERE service_name = 'aibiGenie' AND action_name IN ('createConversationMessage', 'genieStartConversationMessage', 'genieCreateConversationMessage')     AND request_params['space_id'] IS NOT NULL ), dates AS (SELECT DISTINCT event_date AS dt FROM daily) SELECT d.dt AS event_date,   (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT email) FROM daily WHERE event_date = d.dt) AS dau,   (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT email) FROM daily WHERE event_date BETWEEN date_sub(d.dt, 6) AND d.dt) AS trailing_7d,   (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT email) FROM daily WHERE event_date BETWEEN date_sub(d.dt, 27) AND d.dt) AS trailing_28d FROM dates d ORDER BY d.dt

datasets.name: ds_repeat_trend
queryLines: WITH askers AS (   SELECT user_identity.email AS email, event_date FROM system.access.audit   WHERE service_name = 'aibiGenie' AND action_name IN ('createConversationMessage', 'genieStartConversationMessage', 'genieCreateConversationMessage')     AND request_params['space_id'] IS NOT NULL ), monthly_askers AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', event_date) AS month_start, email, MIN(event_date) AS first_ask FROM askers GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', event_date), email), returners AS (   SELECT ma.month_start, ma.email FROM monthly_askers ma   INNER JOIN askers a2 ON ma.email = a2.email AND a2.event_date > ma.first_ask AND a2.event_date <= date_add(ma.first_ask, 7)   GROUP BY ma.month_start, ma.email ) SELECT ma.month_start, COUNT(DISTINCT ma.email) AS total_askers, COUNT(DISTINCT r.email) AS returners,   ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT r.email) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ma.email), 0), 2) AS repeat_rate FROM monthly_askers ma LEFT JOIN returners r ON ma.month_start = r.month_start AND ma.email = r.email GROUP BY ma.month_start ORDER BY ma.month_start

datasets.name: ds_latency_trend
queryLines: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', start_time) AS month_start, COUNT(*) AS total_queries,   SUM(CASE WHEN execution_status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_queries,   ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN execution_status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 3) AS unanswered_rate,   ROUND(AVG(total_duration_ms) / 1000.0, 1) AS avg_latency_sec,   ROUND(PERCENTILE(total_duration_ms, 0.5) / 1000.0, 1) AS p50_latency_sec,   ROUND(PERCENTILE(total_duration_ms, 0.95) / 1000.0, 1) AS p95_latency_sec,   ROUND(SUM(total_duration_ms) / 1000.0 / 3600.0, 2) AS compute_hours FROM system.query.history WHERE query_source.genie_space_id IS NOT NULL AND start_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', start_time) ORDER BY month_start

datasets.name: ds_space_health
queryLines: WITH space_last AS (   SELECT request_params['space_id'] AS space_id, MAX(event_date) AS last_activity   FROM system.access.audit WHERE service_name = 'aibiGenie'     AND action_name IN ('createConversationMessage', 'genieStartConversationMessage', 'genieCreateConversationMessage')     AND request_params['space_id'] IS NOT NULL   GROUP BY request_params['space_id'] ) SELECT CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(current_date(), last_activity) <= 7 THEN 'Active (last 7 days)'   WHEN DATEDIFF(current_date(), last_activity) <= 30 THEN 'Cooling Off (8-30 days)'   ELSE 'Stale (30+ days)' END AS space_status, COUNT(*) AS space_count FROM space_last GROUP BY 1

queryLines: SELECT   a.event_date,   a.user_identity.email AS email,   a.request_params['space_id'] AS space_id,   COALESCE(w.workspace_name, CAST(a.workspace_id AS STRING)) AS workspace_name,   COALESCE(sn.space_name, CONCAT('Unnamed (', LEFT(a.request_params['space_id'], 8), '...)')) lp.cloud       AND u.usage_start_time >= lp.price_start_time AND (lp.price_end_time IS NULL OR u.usage_start_time < lp.price_end_time)     WHERE u.billing_origin_product = 'SQL' AND usage_metadata.warehouse_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2, 3   ), dqt AS (     SELECT DATE(start_time) AS event_date, compute.warehouse_id AS wh_id, workspace_id,       SUM(total_duration_ms) AS total_ms, SUM(CASE WHEN client_application = 'Databricks SQL Genie Space' THEN total_duration_ms ELSE 0 END) AS genie_ms     FROM system.query.history GROUP BY 1, 2, 3   )   SELECT dw.event_date, ROUND(SUM(dw.total_cost_usd * dqt.genie_ms / NULLIF(dqt.total_ms, 0)), 2) AS genie_cost_usd   FROM dw JOIN dqt ON dw.event_date = dqt.event_date AND dw.wh_id = dqt.wh_id AND dw.workspace_id = dqt.workspace_id   WHERE dqt.genie_ms > 0 GROUP BY dw.event_date ) SELECT q.event_date,   ROUND(q.questions * 1.0 / q.users, 1) AS questions_per_user,   ROUND(COALESCE(c.genie_cost_usd, 0) / NULLIF(q.questions, 0), 4) AS cost_per_question,   ROUND(COALESCE(c.genie_cost_usd, 0) / NULLIF(q.users, 0), 2) AS cost_per_user,   ROUND(COALESCE(c.genie_cost_usd, 0) / NULLIF(q.spaces, 0), 2) AS cost_per_space FROM daily_questions q LEFT JOIN daily_cost c ON q.event_date = c.event_date

queryLines: WITH space_last AS (   SELECT request_params['space_id'] AS space_id, MAX(event_date) AS last_activity   FROM system.access.audit WHERE service_name = 'aibiGenie'     AND action_name IN ('createConversationMessage', 'genieStartConversationMessage', 'genieCreateConversationMessage')     AND request_params['space_id'] IS NOT NULL   GROUP BY request_params['space_id'] ) SELECT   (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM space_last WHERE DATEDIFF(current_date(), last_activity) > 30) AS stale_spaces,   current_date() AS as_of_date

lines: SQL warehouse spend across workspaces (last 30 days). Includes all SQL workloads — Genie, dashboards, notebooks, and jobs.
Per-user and per-workspace Genie consumption for cost attribution. Shows who is using Genie, how much, and where — the foundation for showback and chargeback.
How deeply are users engaging with Genie? Are they coming back? Is quality improving?
Trailing 28-day activity, engagement quality, and operational health

This dashboard monitors Genie Space adoption and usage across your Databricks account. It pulls data exclusively from **Unity Catalog system tables** (`system.access.audit` and `system.access.workspaces_latest`), meaning it works across all workspaces without any additional setup. The global **Date Range** filter at the top applies to time-series charts on every page.

**Total Spaces** — Distinct Genie Spaces with any question activity, ever.

**Active Spaces** — Spaces with at least one question in the last 30 days.

**Active Users** — Distinct users who asked at least one question.

**DAU** — Daily Active Users (yesterday).

**Repeat Rate (7d)** — Of all users who asked a question, what % came back to ask another within 7 days. Measures habit formation.

**Satisfaction** — Thumbs up / (thumbs up + thumbs down). Note: only ~4% of questions receive feedback.

**Genie Cost ($)** — Proportional SQL warehouse cost attributed to Genie queries (30d). Calculated as: warehouse_cost * (genie_query_time / total_query_time).

**Avg Cost / Space** — Total Genie cost divided by number of spaces.

**Avg Cost / Question** — Total Genie cost divided by number of questions asked.

**Avg Questions / User** — Total questions divided by total distinct users.

**Stale Spaces (30d+)** — Spaces with no question activity in over 30 days.

**Compute Hours** — Total SQL execution time for all Genie queries.

**Executive Summary** — Account-wide KPIs, activity status breakdown (how many spaces are active vs. inactive), user satisfaction, the fastest-growing workspaces, and daily trend lines for questions asked and active users.

**Workspace Overview** — The same KPIs broken down by workspace. Use the Workspace filter to drill into a specific workspace. Includes side-by-side comparisons of questions and users across workspaces, plus activity status and satisfaction charts.

**All Spaces (Genie Space Explorer)** — Drill into individual Genie Spaces. Select a space from the filter or click on the Top 10 bar chart to see its activity over time, feedback breakdown, and full inventory table.

**Growth & Trends** — Period-over-period comparison showing which spaces are growing or declining. Select a comparison window (Last 7, 30, or 90 days) and optionally filter by workspace. The bar chart shows % growth per space. Click any bar to see that space's daily questions and users for both the current and previous period. Green = growing, red/teal = declining.

**Feedback & Quality** — Overall feedback distribution (positive vs. negative) and satisfaction scores by space.

Genie Space names are not stored in system tables at creation time. This dashboard resolves names by looking for `updateSpace` audit events, which capture the display name whenever a space is renamed. Spaces that have never been renamed appear as **"Unnamed Space (id...)"**. To improve name coverage, ensure space owners give their spaces a descriptive name — the next dashboard refresh will pick it up automatically.

**Date Range** (global) — Applies to all time-series charts across every page. Adjusts the date window for daily trend lines.

**Workspace** (Workspace Overview, Growth & Trends) — Page-level filter. Narrows all visuals on that page to a single workspace.

**Genie Space** (All Spaces) — Page-level filter. Select a specific space to see its activity trend, feedback, and details.

**Compare Period** (Growth & Trends) — Switches between Last 7, 30, or 90 days for the growth comparison. The current period is compared against an equivalent prior window (e.g., Last 30 days compares the most recent 30 days vs. the 30 days before that).

**Cross-click filtering** — On Growth & Trends, clicking a bar in the growth chart filters the line charts and detail table to that specific space.

**Data Sources** — All data comes from two system tables:
- `system.access.audit` — Every Genie interaction (filtered to `service_name = 'aibiGenie'`). Actions include message creation, conversation starts, feedback submissions, and space updates.
- `system.access.workspaces_latest` — Maps workspace IDs to human-readable workspace names.

These are account-level tables accessible via Unity Catalog, so this dashboard captures activity from **all workspaces** in the account.

**SQL Views** (in `genie_monitoring.dashboard`):

`genie_space_inventory` — One row per space. Joins all_spaces (distinct space IDs from audit), space_activity (user counts, message counts, first/last activity dates), space_feedback (thumbs up/down counts), and audit_names (display names from updateSpace events). Activity status is derived from days since last activity: ≤7 days = Active, ≤30 = Recent, >30 = Inactive.

`genie_daily_usage` — One row per (date, space, user). Counts messages sent, conversations started, and feedback events per user per day.

`genie_feedback_detail` — One row per feedback event. Maps raw `feedback_rating` values to human labels: THUMBS_UP → Positive, THUMBS_DOWN → Negative.

`genie_growth` — Period-over-period comparison. Cross-joins audit data with three period windows (7/30/90 days). For each space and period, counts current vs. previous questions and users, then computes % change.

**Metric Calculations:**

*Unique Users* = `COUNT(DISTINCT user_identity.email)` from all aibiGenie audit events. Counted once per person regardless of how many spaces or workspaces they use. On the Workspace Overview and All Spaces pages, event-level datasets ensure correct unique counts — each (user, workspace) or (user, space) pair is a distinct row, and the widget aggregates with `COUNT(DISTINCT)`.

*Questions Asked* = Count of audit events where `action_name IN ('createConversationMessage', 'genieStartConversationMessage', 'genieCreateConversationMessage')`. These are the three action types that represent a user sending a message to Genie.

*User Satisfaction* = `SUM(thumbs_up) / (SUM(thumbs_up) + SUM(thumbs_down))` across all spaces. This is a globally weighted percentage — a space with 50 ratings has more influence than one with 2 ratings. On drill-down pages, event-level datasets ensure the same weighted calculation by representing each feedback event as a row with `is_positive` (1.0 or 0.0), and the widget uses `AVG(is_positive)`.

*Activity Status* = Based on `DATEDIFF(current_date, last_activity_date)`: ≤7 days → "Active (last 7 days)", 8–30 days → "Recent (8-30 days ago)", >30 days → "Inactive (30+ days)". Categories are mutually exclusive.

*Growth %* = `(current_period_questions - previous_period_questions) / previous_period_questions * 100`. If previous = 0 and current > 0, shown as 100%. If both = 0, shown as 0%. Trend label: Growing if change ≥ 0, Declining if < 0.

**Key Audit Log Fields:**

- `request_params.space_id` — Identifies which Genie Space the event belongs to. Events with NULL or 'new' space_id are excluded.
- `request_params.feedback_rating` — THUMBS_UP or THUMBS_DOWN on feedback events.
- `request_params.display_name` — Captured on `updateSpace` events; this is how space names are resolved.
- `user_identity.email` — The email of the user who performed the action.
- `workspace_id` — Joined to `system.access.workspaces_latest` to get workspace names.
- `action_name` — The type of event (message creation, feedback, space update, etc.).

**Cross-Workspace Coverage** — Because `system.access.audit` is an account-level table in Unity Catalog, this dashboard automatically captures Genie usage from every workspace in the account. No per-workspace setup is required. The dashboard can be deployed in any workspace and will show the same account-wide data. Workspace names are resolved via `system.access.workspaces_latest`.
